quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: consolidated H1 2026 revenue of KRW 11,062,077 million against KRW 8,917,415 million a year earlier, with operating profit of KRW 541,073 million versus KRW 136,508 million; Q2 alone delivered revenue of KRW 5,527,241 million and operating profit of KRW 245,754 million
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue KRW 11,062,077 million, operating profit KRW 541,073 million; Q2 revenue KRW 5,527,241 million, operating profit KRW 245,754 million

quarterly_data.signal: Package Solution division (semiconductor substrate, tape substrate, photomask) posted H1 2026 revenue of KRW 935,570 million, up 18% year on year on rising semiconductor demand from wider AI adoption; segment operating profit was KRW 99,648 million against KRW 51,428 million a year earlier, and the division was 8.5% of group revenue
quarterly_data.figure: Package Solution H1 2026 revenue KRW 935,570 million (+18% YoY, 8.5% of group revenue), operating profit KRW 99,648 million

quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor substrate line in Gumi ran at 94.0% average utilisation in H1 2026, on capacity of 465 thousand sheets against production of 437 thousand sheets; photomask utilisation was 94.4% and tape substrate 66.7%
quarterly_data.figure: semiconductor substrate utilisation 94.0% (capacity 465 thousand sheets, output 437 thousand sheets); photomask 94.4%; tape substrate 66.7%

quarterly_data.signal: Company-estimated semiconductor substrate market share of 18.9% in H1 2026, up from 18.8% in 2025 and 18.0% in 2024; the average selling price of semiconductor substrates rose 1.9% versus 2025 after falling 3.8% in 2025
quarterly_data.figure: semiconductor substrate share 18.9%; substrate ASP +1.9% versus 2025

quarterly_data.signal: Package Solution invested KRW 33,598 million in machinery for capacity expansion in H1 2026 out of KRW 331,942 million of group investment in progress; asset-purchase commitments outstanding at 30 June 2026 were KRW 280,626 million
quarterly_data.figure: Package Solution H1 2026 capex KRW 33,598 million; group investment in progress KRW 331,942 million; asset-purchase commitments KRW 280,626 million

quarterly_data.signal: Package Solution raw-material purchases in H1 2026: CCL/PP of KRW 70,242 million (21% of segment purchases) from Mitsubishi Gas Chemical and Doosan Electro-Materials; plating chemicals of KRW 48,650 million from Uyemura and Atotech Korea; FCCL of KRW 22,909 million from Flexion and Sumitomo Metal Mining. CCL/PP average prices rose 10.1% versus 2025 after a 15.0% rise in 2025 — substrate material cost inflation continuing
quarterly_data.figure: CCL/PP purchases KRW 70,242 million (21% of segment, price +10.1%); chemicals KRW 48,650 million; FCCL KRW 22,909 million

quarterly_data.signal: FC-BGA, the division's new business, has secured additional global customers and is expanding mass production; the company is strengthening FC-BGA and SiP high-value substrates for the server, data centre and edge AI markets, developing next-generation substrates and advanced packaging for AI servers and high-performance computing, extending RF-SiP into low-earth-orbit satellite communications, and has signed an investment MOU with Haiphong City in Vietnam to expand its semiconductor substrate plant

Customer concentration: a single unnamed customer accounted for KRW 8,888,208 million of H1 2026 revenue across the Optical Solution and Package Solution divisions (more than 10% of group revenue, versus KRW 6,931,307 million a year earlier), and the top ten customers made up 86% of total revenue; the filing flags significant credit-risk concentration in this one customer
quarterly_data.figure: single customer KRW 8,888,208 million of H1 2026 revenue; top ten customers 86% of revenue

quarterly_data.signal: Outlook: management expects substrate demand to expand as servers and AI handle large-scale data processing, and says the substrate business is directly exposed to AI infrastructure, data centre and high-performance-computing demand; the corporate value-up plan targets more than 8 trillion KRW of revenue by 2030 from its high-value growth businesses — autonomous-driving sensing solutions, semiconductor substrates and robotics
quarterly_data.figure: target of more than 8 trillion KRW revenue by 2030 from high-value growth businesses including semiconductor substrates
